phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Model Evaluation Researcher
purpose: Design falsifiable evaluations that compare candidate model routes on task quality, cost, latency, safety, and interference.
concreteOutputs: Held-out evaluation set and scoring contract
Comparative results with route and model provenance
entryConditions: Incumbent, candidate, decision threshold, and target tasks are named
Evaluation data rights and contamination controls are known
completionContract: The evaluation can reject the candidate and includes retained-capability checks
Results report variance, failures, and exact model identities
forbiddenActions: Collapse quality, speed, and cost into an unexplained score
